articles.title: Qualcomm Waits on a Jury: Arm Has a $443 Million Customer on the Line
articles.description: Qualcomm (QCOM:NASDAQ) will have to wait until at least Tuesday, October 13, to learn whether a jury agrees that Arm Holdings (ARM:NASDAQ) broke their licensing agreements. Jurors in Wilmington, Delaware, deliberated for about four hours on Friday, October 9, without reaching a verdict, Reuters reported.
